## AI & LLM News (2025‑02‑17 → 2025‑02‑23)

### Major Model Releases & Tooling
- **GPT‑5 “Orion” preview** – OpenAI began limited public preview in ChatGPT mobile app (Feb 18‑20). First unified model replacing o‑series & GPT‑4.5; early benchmarks show 30‑40 % coding gain (SWE‑bench) and lower hallucination. Full release slated for Mar‑Apr 2025. *[The Information, Feb 19](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/openai-begins-testing-gpt-5-orion-in-chatgpt-app) | [TechCrunch, Feb 20](https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/20/openai-starts-rolling-out-gpt-5-orion-to-select-chatgpt-users/)]*

- **Gemini 2.5 Pro Flash** – Google DeepMind launched a hybrid “thinking + fast” model (Feb 21). 80.1 % GPQA, 10× faster & 5× cheaper than full Gemini 2.5 Pro; 2 M token context. Live on Vertex AI & Gemini API. *[Google AI Blog, Feb 21](https://blog.google/technology/ai/gemini-2-5-pro-flash/)* 

- **Codestral 25.02** – Mistral released a code‑focused LLM (Feb 18). 256 k context, 40 % less copy‑paste duplication, 95.2 % HumanEval. Adds “autonomous diffing” – generates patches for existing codebases. Apache 2.0 license, self‑hostable & on Mistral La Plateforme. *[Mistral blog, Feb 18](https://mistral.ai/news/codestral-2502)*  

- **Llama 4 Scout & Maverick (leaked)** – HF repo accidentally exposed 300 B (Scout, 16‑expert) and 400 B (Maverick, 32‑expert) models (Feb 19). New “interleaved attention” with 10 M token effective context. Official release planned for Mar 2025 (internal posts). Scout leads DeepSeek‑V3 on MMLU‑Pro by 2.1 pts. *[HF repo, Feb 19](https://huggingface.co/models?search=llama-4-scout) | Reuters, Feb 20](https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/meta-ai-leak-llama-4-weights/)*  

### Desktop App & Inference Tooling
- **vLLM 0.7.0** – Added PagedCache (‑45 % GPU memory fragmentation) and FlashAttention‑3 support; up to 3.1× throughput on Llama‑3‑70B for 8 k tokens. Includes quantization‑aware speculative decoding. Recommended for production inference. *[vLLM release, Feb 19](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/releases/tag/v0.7.0)*  

- **Ollama Cloud & LoRA fine‑tune** – Ollama launched managed API hosting (beta) and built‑in LoRA CLI (`ollama fine‑tune`) (Feb 20). Small models (e.g., Qwen2.5‑7B) can be fine‑tuned on a single RTX 4090 in <2 h. *[Ollama blog, Feb 20](https://ollama.com/blog/cloud-and-finetune)*  

- **SmolLM3 & Transformers 5.0 alpha** – Hugging Face released efficient 0.5 B, 1.7 B, 3 B models (Feb 20) beating Phi‑3.5‑mini & Qwen2.5‑1.5B on reasoning while 40 % smaller. Transformers v5.0 adds a unified tokenizer (200+ tokenizers) and 2× generation speed; PyTorch 1.x compatibility removed. *[SmolLM3 card, Feb 20](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B) | Transformers v5 alpha, Feb 21](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/releases/tag/v5.0.0-alpha.0)*  

- **AI Shell (Microsoft)** – CLI tool that embeds an LLM into PowerShell/Bash (Feb 17). Generates commands from natural language and includes a “system trace” that lets the LLM introspect GPU/memory usage to auto‑tune on‑device inference (switch GPU↔CPU). Available for Windows 11 and WSL. *[Azure AI blog, Feb 17](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/ai-shell-preview/)*  

### Agent Swarm & Orchestration
- **LangChain v0.4 “Lingua”** – Declarative YAML framework for multi‑agent systems (Feb 17). New features: built‑in “tool‑switching on failure” (auto‑fallback to another provider) and LangGraph Studio visual debugger showing token‑by‑token reasoning. Breaking API change. *[LangChain release, Feb 17](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/releases/tag/v0.4.0)*  

- **Anthropic Contextual Memory Agents (CMA)** – Research paper introducing persistent‑state RAG (Feb 18). Improves LongBench‑Plus accuracy by 18.7 % vs naive RAG and reduces token use by 32 % through re‑use of context. Implemented as optional experimental feature in Claude API. *[Anthropic research, Feb 18](https://www.anthropic.com/research/contextual-memory-agents)*  

### Edge & On‑Device AI
- **Nemotron‑360M** – Nvidia’s 0.36 B model optimized for on‑device generation (Feb 18). Runs on Raspberry Pi 5 at 12 t/s, 2‑bit PTQ quantization, 96 % of 7 B model performance on tiny reasoning (GSM8K). Intended as fallback for hybrid cloud inference. *[Nvidia blog, Feb 18](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/nemotron-edge-360m/)*  

### Compliance & Policy
- **EU AI Act enforcement** – First binding provisions took effect Feb 20. Prohibited practices: social scoring, manipulative deepfakes, real‑time biometric ID in public spaces. High‑risk domains (HR, healthcare, finance) require mandatory bias audits. Providers added “EU mode” API endpoints with automatic bias testing. *[EU Commission AI Act timeline, Feb 20](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/ai-act-timeline)*  

---

**What this means for a developer building AI‑powered desktop apps & agent swarms (as of Feb 2025):**

- **Model choice**: Use Codestral 25.02 for code‑centric tasks, SmolLM3 for lightweight agents, and consider the upcoming Llama 4 family for high‑scale reasoning (pending official release).  
- **Inference speed**: vLLM 0.7.0 and Ollama Cloud give you fast, memory‑efficient serving; fine‑tune locally with Ollama’s LoRA for custom domain knowledge.  
- **Agent orchestration**: Migrate to LangChain v0.4 (Lingua) for YAML‑based multi‑agent builds and leverage its failure‑fallback tooling. Pair with Anthropic’s CMA for persistent memory in swarms.  
- **On‑device fallback**: Integrate Nemotron‑360M for offline assistance on low‑spec hardware; AI Shell provides a CLI wrapper with auto‑resource tuning.  
- **Compliance**: If targeting EU users, enable bias‑testing capabilities and monitor EU‑mode API endpoints to stay within the AI Act requirements.  

*All dates are based on UTC and sourced from the linked primary materials.*
